references.text: Nations ask why the Lord has done this to the land and the temple, and the answer is that Israel abandoned the Lord their God. Same theme of nations wondering about God's judgment.
All who pass by will be horrified and ask why the Lord has done this to the land. Parallel wording about the nations' reaction to God's judgment.
Many nations shall pass by the city and ask one another why the Lord has done such things to this great city. Same motif of the nations asking questions.
Jeremiah explains that the Lord's wrath comes because the people abandoned him. Explanation of the great wrath mentioned in Deuteronomy 29:23.
All who pass by clap their hands and ask if this is the city. Describes the nations' reaction to Jerusalem's destruction.
The prophet speaks about the day of the Lord's great wrath. Thematic connection to 'the great wrath' in the original text.
